name: Granola
description: Your Granola meeting notes and transcripts, searchable from the chat.
long_description:
Granola's hosted server. It searches your meeting notes and transcripts and reads one in full, so "what did we decide about the pricing page" is a question you can ask here.

You sign in through Granola in your browser.

auth.instructions: Sign in to Granola in your browser; the server registers Gantry on the spot.

risk.notes: Reads the meeting notes your Granola account holds.
